# Materialization rules

A knowledge note normally needs two independent sources. One reviewed
authoritative source is sufficient when it explicitly defines the topic; record
the single-source scope in the review record.

Only reviewed `BINDING` sources can support an obligation or prohibition. Other sources support expectations, recommendations, controls, or context. Dataset observations remain descriptive.

Express useful relationships as Obsidian links in context. Preserve conflicting
positions as separately attributed evidence-backed statements. Do not create a
placeholder note merely to complete a link.

A possible taxonomy change becomes `NEW_DOMAIN`, `ALIAS`, `MERGE`, or `SUBDOMAIN`. Existing active IDs remain stable; human review decides the proposal.
